messages:
devon: quick q — designing internal API for routing + quotas across hosted/dedicated/private. leaning toward gRPC for perf, but worried about gateway complexity and rollout UX.

marta: +1 gRPC for internal -> lower latency and streaming for infer. proto schemas give us strict contracts which help platform.

sam: downside is browser/edge clients and some services talk HTTP/JSON. you'll need a gateway or transcoding anyway.

ana: gateway transcoding + envoy is fine, but watch header propagation for quota/tenant. we need trace-id + tenant-id + billing-tags on every request.

devon: yeah — how do we handle quotas? per-tenant rate limits at gateway vs token bucket in runtime? mixing makes telemetry messy.

marta: prefer central quota at gateway for simple rejects and billing, but runtime should emit usage events so console shows per-route token counts.

sam: propose: gateway enforces soft quota (429 after threshold) and attaches x-usage-allowance header with remaining tokens. runtime consumes tokens and emits events to kafka.

ana: snippet for header:
```
X-Tenant-ID: tenant_123
X-Trace-ID: 8a1b2c3d
X-Quota-Allowance: 12345
```

marta: for proto -> add a Metadata message in all RPCs:
```
message Metadata { string tenant_id = 1; string trace_id = 2; map<string,string> tags = 3; }
```

pm-josh: from console UX POV we need explicit rollout toggle per-tenant + per-model variant, and visibility into what fallback model fired on quota/latency errors.

devon: agreed. rollout toggles should surface potential latency/cost impact before enabling.

ana: telemetry: make sure gateway emits span + decision tags (route=primary|fallback, quota=charged|billed_out). that'll make dashboards clean.

infra-bot: canary-deploy started for gateway v3 -> rolling 10% traffic to new transcoding rules :rocket:

sam: tiny nit — keep our gateway stateless re: tokens. use redis for counters to make rollout easier.

marta: +1 redis counters + kafka events for billing/observability.

devon: ok next steps: prototype gRPC with proto-metadata + envoy HTTP JSON transcoding, add x-quota-allowance header, and wire events to kafka. i'll sketch RFC.

pm-josh: cheers. can you add expected UX mock for rollout toggle? I can help.

devon: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
